title: Nothing to Declare
subtitle: Impossible cargo. Very real paperwork.
description: Work a six-traveller shift at an interdimensional customs desk. Model-driven merchants choose hidden cargo, make dubious declarations and negotiate real terms; your instruments, regulations and stamps decide what crosses.
instruction: Configure a model and call a traveller. Compare declarations with measured evidence and current regulations, negotiate if useful, then stamp Admit, Quarantine or Return.
